title: Letter spacing: compile to SWF via DoAction setTextFormat
description:
The `letterSpacing` property exists in the FlashDocument model (core/src/model/timeline.ts), is editable in PropertiesPanel, and is preserved in the document. However packages/swf/src/text.ts line 280 has an explicit TODO: it is never compiled to the SWF output. As a result, any text field with non-zero letter spacing renders with default spacing in Ruffle.

Fix: for each text DisplayObject that has a non-zero `letterSpacing` value, emit a DoAction tag on the same frame (after PlaceObject2) containing AVM1 bytecode that calls:
  var tf = new TextFormat(); tf.letterSpacing = N; instanceName.setTextFormat(tf);
The AVM1 bytecode follows the same pattern as the existing compileAS2 pipeline (push strings, numbers, ActionNew, ActionSetMember, ActionCallMethod, etc.).

Acceptance:
1. Unit test: a compiled SWF for a dynamic text field with letterSpacing=5 contains a DoAction tag whose AVM1 bytecode includes the string 'letterSpacing', the value 5, and 'setTextFormat'.
2. E2E oracle: a Ruffle-rendered screenshot of a text field with letterSpacing=10 differs non-trivially (pixelDiff > 500) from the same text at letterSpacing=0, proving Ruffle applied the spacing.

Files: packages/swf/src/text.ts (remove TODO, implement), packages/swf/src/compile.ts (plumb per-text DoAction emission), apps/desktop/e2e/text-rendering.spec.ts or a new spec.
